question: ________ are a kind of waste disposal system of the cell.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lysosomes**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lysosomes**:-

 
 
• These are small, spherical organelles that contain digestive enzymes.
 
• They are responsible for breaking down a wide variety of cellular waste products, including worn-out organelles, food particles, and bacteria.
 
• Lysosomes are also involved in recycling cellular components, such as amino acids and proteins. 
 
• **Lysosomes are a kind of waste disposal system of the cell.**
 
• Lysosomes are essential for maintaining cell health and function.
 
• If lysosomes are not functioning properly, cellular waste products can build up and damage the cell.
 
• This can lead to a variety of diseases, including cancer and lysosomal storage diseases.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ribosome**:-

 
 
• ** A ribosome is a complex molecular machine that synthesizes proteins from amino acids. **
 
• It is found in all living cells, both prokaryotic and eukaryotic. Ribosomes are made up of two subunits, a large one and a small one.
 
• The small subunit binds to messenger RNA (mRNA) and decodes the genetic code, while the large subunit adds amino acids to the growing polypeptide chain.
 
 
 
• **Mitochondria**:-
 
 
• **Mitochondria, often referred to as the "powerhouses of the cell," are specialized organelles found in most eukaryotic organisms. **
 
• They are primarily responsible for energy production in the form of ATP (adenosine triphosphate) through the process of oxidative phosphorylation.
 
 
 
• **Vacuoles**:-
 
 
• **These are membrane-bound organelles present in all plant and fungal cells and some protist, animal and bacterial cells. **
 
• They're essentially enclosed compartments filled with water containing inorganic and organic molecules, including enzymes.
